method.precision: float64 coverage; ordinary storage rounding is not a research target
method.raw_frames: SVD of image-minus-start; PCA subtracts neighborhood mean first; no whitening
method.latent_coordinates: Five dot products of image-minus-start with measured local basis
method.data_only_decoder: Ordinary least-squares explicit quadratic image formula in five measured coordinates; no renderer formula
method.geometry_assistance: State-derived top, bottom, intercept, width, slope and their explicit conversion to original controls
method.derivative_targets: Known derivatives enter evaluation and sampler initialization only, never calibration/fitting targets
method.sampling: 512 new independently sampled filled-neighborhood images for chart fits; 256 new held-out joint moves
method.sampling_bounds: Two-sided local rays may extend position bounds below 14 as in prior root fits; full 32 new starts use interior default box
method.repeats: Original 61 saved neighborhoods plus 32 new five-dimensional source states
